provenance.method: Source asset SHA-256 values retain the exact ranged responses measured on 2026-10-10. The installed foundation rc6 downloader is byte-identical to that source. These are locally recorded content pins, not a separate publisher checksum attestation. The rc6 WASM hash is measured from the integrity-locked package; the derived G1 output hash remains an expected mathematical-content constraint pending a fresh rc6 derivation. Grumpkin was reacquired on 2026-10-13 as the exact 0-8388607 range of the 16777216-byte official v2 file (HTTP 206, identity encoding). Both complete 4194304-byte chunks matched the canonical barretenberg/cpp/src/barretenberg/srs/factories/grumpkin_crs_data.hpp anchors in pinned Aztec source 0df91ba1799012435c62c6108a0926b357fef88c: 64236c9455e75aeea77a94587ea607eed2e978d2609a421d66bf10bb9698b8fd and f4acd78e415e4db21fb237888c23105f4919d30e18226faa470a11aec69e49bb. The original 65537-point prefix retained SHA-256 b4988c0ae3dd058b781045aeb70000d7b7fb5ffe557ed4f81c64b437c39a61c9. The new whole-file pin was measured only after those checks.
provenance.pointBudget: BN254 preserves at least the existing 1048577-point capacity, rounded to the next 131072-point/4MiB compressed chunk. Grumpkin preserves at least 65537 points by rounding up to 131072 points/two complete 65536-point chunks. Capacity for production proofs is verified separately.
